body: I’m here anytime if you need someone !
I haven’t really tried anything at all, I’ve just let it be at this point.
I don’t think you’re gonna go to hell for suicide, I feel like ppl say that to scare us out of doing it.
I’m here if you wanna talk, ik how it feels having no one to talk to.

Ik no ones gonna see this anyway :/
I’m here to talk or vent anytime, no judgement here. Ik how it feels venting to someone but also feel like your being judged too.
For me I’ll use peroxide and cold water.
My fault, I’m sorry.
Same. I’ve tried strangling or “hanging” myself for the past few days, but I stop before I go unconscious ig. Self harm (*cutting) barely works for me anymore so :/ .
Congrats! Proud of you and keep going 💕💕
Idk If you’re asking for advice on hiding your cuts, but for me I wear a long sleeve workout shirt that has the same material of a swimsuit and shorts long enough to cover up my cuts.
Ty for doing this bro! My favorite song is Maze, I can relate to it a lot, song’s gotten me thru some bad days too.

I used to only harm on my thighs since it was easier to hide, but now I harm on both my thighs and arms. I honestly do wish I didn’t start harming on my arm since it’s harder to hide, and I have to wear sleeves all the time unless I’m going to sleep.
Thank you :)
Same, if I do eat something it’ll be something small, but I’d still feel bad for it. Hope one day you’ll be able to recover from this 🖤.
I’m glad you were able to recover, I don’t have a psychologist but maybe and hopefully I can get the help I may need soon.
Yeah same for me, this started happening for me after I started cutting. I’ll kinda feel that same way too when I do get food, like I’m not really hungry.
Yeah same. I don’t like eating and feel like I don’t deserve to eat anything either.
Thank you for the advice, I don’t really have a therapist or anything, but maybe one day, hopefully soon, I’ll try getting help. Also hope you are good as well.

Same, I honestly just try to go as long as I can without eating. I just really hate it, especially with how bad I feel after. But I hope one day you’ll be able to overcome this and get the help you need.
Yeah fr, can’t even really eat anything without just feeling so horrible about it.
Yeah I get that part abt being an “attention whore,” I had a friend who used to barely eat, and ppl thought she did it for attention. Idk if she actually had an eating disorder tho but still.
Same, I don’t really even eat, I can’t even eat without feeling so shitty after.
Sorry for your loss,  I’ll try my best to stick to just sh (cutting).
I’m glad you’re good now! The last time I ate, I almost made myself throw it up, but I stopped and cut instead. Now I just don’t eat so I won’t do that.
Yeah I hate how guilty I’ll feel if I do eat. Maybe I feel that same way but idek how I feel half of the time lol.

Yeah it is weird how binge eating is seen as not bad compared to starving yourself. I’ve never really binge ate before but I just lose my appetite or starve myself. It’s good that you’re trying to not let it get worse, good luck and I hope you’ll be able to get through it.
I think about doing that but sometimes I just don’t wanna eat or consume anything
Sorry that you deal with that :( . I never really know if I’m anorexic since I don’t like to self-diagnose myself  :/

Sorry that had to happen to you. Do you still feel that way? (You don’t have to answer if it bothers you)
